internal_diagnostics: In-band protocol-layer error reporting via Acknowledge and Error Report Short Packet (DT=0x02) carrying 16-bit error mask.
Header ECC (Hamming-modified 24,8) — single-bit correction + 2-bit detection on every Packet Header.
Long Packet Checksum (CRC-16, poly x^16+x^12+x^5+1, init 0xFFFF, LSB-first) over payload bytes only.
EoTp Short Packet (DT=0x08, payload 0x0F0F, ECC 0x01) as a protocol-layer end-of-HS marker decoupled from PHY EoT characteristics.
Contention recovery timers (HRX_TO, HTX_TO, LTX-P_TO, LRX-H_TO) provide bounded recovery without hard reset.
Optional Turnaround Acknowledge Timeout (TA_TO) and Peripheral Reset Timeout (PR_TO).
Annex B reference CRC-16 test vectors (gpcTestData0..3) act as known-good regression inputs.

scan_topology.vendor_BIST_extensions: Some commercial DSI master / slave IP cores (e.g. from Synopsys / Cadence / silicon vendors) add MIPI DSI BIST and PHY loopback test modes, but these are NOT part of the DSI v1.01.00 specification.

fields.notes: DSI v1.01.00 does NOT define standard scan or JTAG mechanisms. Debug relies on (a) the in-band 16-bit Error Report returned via Acknowledge and Error Report Short Packet after BTA, (b) Header ECC and Payload Checksum integrity checks, and (c) the EoTp Short Packet as a protocol-layer end-of-transmission marker. Production-line characterization adds eye-diagram measurements and the MIPI Alliance Conformance Test Suite procedures on top. Vendor IP commonly layers BIST, loopback, and eye-monitor on top of the standard.
